text.en: may be cited as the Mosque Construction Fund Rules, 2026 and shall commence on the same date as the Religious Council and Kadis Courts Act (Amendment) Order, 2026.

In these Rules, unless the context otherwise requires"assets" includes movable and immovable properties of various nature; the Board of Trustees of the Mosque Construction Fund by rule 3; the Chairman of the Board appointed under rule 4(1); "financial year" means a period of 12 months ending on the 31st day of of every year; "Secretariat" means the Secretariat to the Fund appointed under rule 14.

PART2

OF TRUSTEES
There shall be established a Board of Trustees called the Board of Trustees of the Mosque Construction Fund which shall fully benefit the application of the Fund.
All members of the Board are deemed to be public servants for the of the Penal Code (Chapter 22).

(1) The Chairman shall summon meetings of the Board as often as may be but not less than once in 4 months.

(2) At every meeting of the Board, a quorum shall consist of seven including the Chairman or the Deputy Chairman, and decisions shall be by a simple majority of the members present and voting except that in the event of an equality of votes, the Chairman shall have a casting vote.

(3) No business shall, with the exception of adjournment, be transacted and no resolution or action of the Board is valid unless a quorum is present.

(4) The Board may invite to its meeting any person who is not a member of the Board if the business before the meeting renders the presence of such desirable and the person so invited is entitled to take part in the discussion, but not to vote.

(5) Subject to the provisions of these Rules, the Board may determine its own meeting procedure and make regulations for carrying out its duties.

(6) The Board shall cause proper records of its meeting proceedings to be kept.

PART3 to Fund

(1) The Department of Mosque Affairs, Ministry of Religious Affairs, shall be the Secretariat to the Fund which shall be responsible for the general and day to day proceedings of the Fund.

(2) The Director of Mosque Mfairs shall be the Head of the Secretariat. Functions and duties of Secretariat

The Secretariat shall be fully responsible to the Board, particularly in but not limited to - (a} collecting, rece1vmg and managing the moneys of the Fund contributed from the public and the government and non-government

(b) planning the project and drafting the project paperwork for source

(c) negotiating with the parties relating to such project; (dJ ensuring the project runs smoothly; (e} preparing and submitting a report on the proceedings of every such project to the Board; (fJ revising, reviewing and distributing the project payment claims for by the Board; (gJ preparing and keeping the accounting records and the financial of the Fund; (hJ preparing and submitting annual reports to the Board; (iJ preparing and submitting budget proposals of the Fund to the (jJ the decisions of the Majlis and such other matters as the Majlis may determine for the purposes of the provisions of the Act and Rules; and (k} such other matters as the Board may direct.

PART4 of Majlis

(1) The Majlis shall have general powers on the Fund to(a} authorise and approve any project proposal of the Fund; (bJ authorise and approve the withdrawal of money collection from the Fund for application under section 123B; and (c} purchase any asset using the money of the Fund if the Majlis it is for the interest of the Fund.

(2) For the purposes of these Rules, the Majlis may accept money for the purposes of application under section 123B.

(3) The Majlis may sell, convey, assign, surrender and produce, dispose of, or mortgage, lease, reassign, transfer or otherwise release, or deal with, any asset of the Fund, vested in the Majlis, if the Majlis considers it is for the of the Fund. to delegate functions and powers

heading.en: Majlis to delegate functions and powers

text.en:
( 1) The Majlis may delegate to the Board the exercise of any power or the of any duty conferred or imposed on the Majlis by these Rules, except for the power of delegation conferred by these Rules.

(2) A delegation under subrule (1) may be made subject to such conditions as the Majlis may determine in the instrument of delegation.

(3) The Majlis may continue to exercise any power and perform any duty or imposed on it notwithstanding the power is delegated to the Board.

(1) The Majlis shall open and maintain such bank accounts for the Fund as it thinks fit.

(2) All moneys received for the application of the Fund by or for the Majlis shall be deposited into the account of the Fund.

(3) Payment by the Majlis for an amount exceeding $50 shall be made by cheque.

(4) Cheques issued on the account of the Fund shall be signed by the or the Vice-President and the Secretary to the Majlis.

PARTS

(1) The accounts and financial statements of the Fund shall be audited by - (a} the Auditor General; or

(b) any person who has been authorised to perform the duties by the Companies Act (Chapter 39) to be performed by an auditor, who shall be appointed annually by the Majlis: that where the accounts of the Fund have been audited by a person under paragraph (b), they may be verified by the Auditor General they are submitted to the Majlis pursuant to rule lZ{d}.

(2) The auditor shall in his report state - (a} whether the financial statements show fairly the financial and the state of affairs of the Fund;

(b) whether proper accounting and other records have been kept, including records of all assets of the Fund whether purchased, donated or

(c) whether the receipts, expenditure, investment of moneys and the and disposal of assets by the Board during the financial year have been in accordance with the Act; and

(d) such other matters arising from the audit as he considers should be reported.

(3) The auditor shall, as soon as practicable after the accounts have been submitted for audit, send a report of his audit to the Board.

(4) The auditor shall submit such periodical and special reports to the and to the Majlis as may appear to him to be necessary or as the Board or the Majlis may require.

(5) The remuneration of the auditor shall be paid out of the Fund. of auditor

(1) The auditor or any person authorised by him is entitled at all reasonable times to full and free access to all accounting and other records relating directly or indirectly to the financial transactions of the Fund.

(2) The auditor or a person authorised by him may make copies of or make extracts from any such accounting and other records.

(3) The auditor may require any person to provide him with such in the possession of that person or to which that person has access as the auditor considers necessary for the purposes of his functions under these · · -

(4) Any person who refuses or fails without any reasonable cause to allow the auditor access to any accounting and other records of the Fund in his custody or power or to give any information possessed by him as and when required or who otherwise hinders, obstructs or delays the auditor in the performance of his or the exercise of his powers under these Rules is guilty of an offence and on conviction to a fine not exceeding $1,000 and, in the case of a continuing further fine not exceeding $100 for every day or part thereof during the offence continues after conviction. of financial statements and audited reports

heading.en: Presentation of financial statements and audited reports

text.en:
(1) As soon as the accounts of the Fund and the financial statements have been audited in accordance with the provisions of these Rules, a copy of the audited financial statements signed by the Chairman, together with a copy of any made by the auditor, shall be submitted to the Majlis.

(2) Where the Auditor General is not the auditor, a copy of the audited financial statements and any report made by the auditor shall be forwarded to the Auditor General at the same time as they are submitted to the Majlis.

(3) The Majlis shall, as soon as practicable, cause a copy of the audited financial statements and of the auditor's report to be presented to His Majesty the and Yang Di-Pertuan.

(4) The audited financial statements shall be published in the Government of money and revenue of Fund
